names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Νίκων ο Ξηρός «ὁ ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ»», with the rank word left off. The by-names «ο Ξηρός» and «ὁ ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ» are left off the stored form.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026). saint.gr calls him a Russian venerable and puts his relic in the Lavra of the Caves at Kyiv, so the Russian calendar is the one that would say most about him, and it has not been read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Νίκων ο Ξηρός «ὁ ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ»»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole content is «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Ρώσου Οσίου» together with a note of his relic, incorrupt in the Lavra of the Caves at Kyiv. No year, so no `dates` object. The corpus keeps a `nikon-of-the-kyiv-caves` with a venerated Greek row on 23 March, the abbot and hieromonk; this entry is «ο Ξηρός», the Dry, on another day, so it is another commemoration and another man, and nothing on either page joins them. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
